name: Secretless Release Automation
description: Release pipeline uses OIDC-based auth, not long-lived secrets. No secrets in environment or config.
purpose: Eliminate long-lived secrets from the release pipeline by replacing them with OIDC-based short-lived credentials so there are no static credentials to leak, rotate, or manage.
acceptanceCriteria: Release pipeline uses OIDC authentication for all cloud provider and registry interactions.
No long-lived secrets (API keys, tokens, passwords) are stored in CI environment variables or config files.
OIDC tokens are short-lived (minutes, not hours) and obtained fresh per release step.
Secret scanning is configured to detect any accidental secret inclusion in release artifacts or logs.
If a legacy secret is required for an external service, it is scoped, rotated, and tracked for removal.
Secretless operation is verified by a CI job that checks for environment secrets before release.
Documentation covers how new release steps should authenticate without secrets.
